tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /khro bo stobs po che'i bsgom bzlas phas rgol rnam gnon bzhugs so// sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan ci rigs/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /lan cig oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal la/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal la bhu mi pa ti dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ stobs chen dkar dmar dud mdud mdog /zhal༞ rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas tho ba gtun shing bsnams/ /mtha' mas phur sgril yum la 'khyud/ mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa khams pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral rked bcing dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /sa bdag pho yi mgo bo dang / /mo yi nu ma rab tu brdzis/ /rdo rje'i khyung gshog rab tu gdengs/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhi maṇ+ḍi na maṃ hūm̐/ rig byed ma ni du ba'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag g.yas dril bu bsnams/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lnga sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcus do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/

/zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ka shi ka mu khī hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs sprul pa'i phyag brnyan ni/ /mdog dkar dom gyi mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje tho ba bsnams/ /g.yon pas phur sgril ro steng bzhugs/ /phra men byi ba'i mgo can g.yon/ /dmar mo gtun shing phur pa bsnams/ /nyi ma'i gdan la gar gyis rol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ oṃ pañca ku la kro dha kro dhi a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ khro bo rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ thugs dkar pad nyi la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas nas rang la thim/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas mthar/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas bden bdar dgug gzhug sogs tshig spyi 'gre brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /stobs chen khro bo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus par/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog/ //sogs bsngo smon bkra shis gang shes brjod/ ces dmag bzlog stobs chen bsgom bzlas/ phur pa sa lugs mthun pa 'di yang sa skya kun blos bris// //sarba dza ga taṃ/ /zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ khro bo stobs po che'i bsgom bzlas phas rgol rnam gnon/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
